findings.summary: H67 paper ckpt is plus10 ep35 after a five-stage rescue; H81 is an uninterrupted 40-epoch fullres run. Crop stage is a clean motion-only control. Fullres comparison is recipe-level only.

DATE_ALGORITHM_CLOSURE_AUDIT_20260805 still records Local5 rank1 as ep29 AEE 1.3286. Paper Table B correctly uses plus10 ep39 AEE 1.3153. Do not read the August 5 closure as the current Local5 number.
DSEC numbers are local valid825, not official hidden test. NB0 AE-3D 6.18 cannot be compared to the published hidden-test 4.871.
No seed1/2 training. Paper must say seed0 only.
MVSEC H67/Local5/NB0 are day2-trained models from the same NB0 init. They are not the DSEC H67 ep35 checkpoint and inherit no DSEC RTL.
Local5 full-sequence indoor_flying1 AEE 1.6282 is worse than NB0 1.5998. The DATE gate correctly rejects Local5.
NB0 fullres uses window [2,15,15] but pretrained_window_size [2,9,9]. H67/H81 use [2,15,15] for both. Geometry matches; relative-position recipe does not.
Resolved after audit: H67 QF5-QF8 now waits for the H67/H81 result and runs before Local5 40-50; Local5 waits for the QF summary.
H81 test.n_valid=1. In-training val loss jumped between 1.18 and 2.31. Epoch selection must use valid825 ep29/34/39 only.
uJ columns are spike-activity proxies, not chip energy.
MVSEC smoke checks overlay_keys=0 missing=210 because H67/Local5 start from NB0. That is the intended init signature, not an inverted eval load.
